name: mergetrain
description: Queue committed branches from parallel LLM coding agents in Git worktrees. Test the combined tree in a local merge queue, require approval for Git pushes, and recover interrupted pushes.

interface.shortDescription: Safely integrate committed branches from parallel coding agents.
interface.longDescription: For local, worktree-first repositories: queue committed branches from parallel coding agents, test the combined tree in order, keep integration pushes under one human-gated owner, and recover interrupted pushes. Not for single-agent work or PR-first repositories already using GitHub Merge Queue or GitLab Merge Trains.
defaultPrompt: Queue my committed agent branches in order, then stop before deployment.
How should I test parallel worktree branches together before one approved push?
Help me recover safely after an interrupted integration push.
